claims.claim: Seven distinct paired-array results across seven bound job IDs; twenty main/quantized frames PNG-byte and RGBA exact. One Pro Flash original/main still pair differs.
Reported original_image_n_colors cannot be treated as color count of exposed main images; the nominal main/quantized arrays are already identical.

Pro Flash same-job original/main pair changes3945/15624 co-visible RGB pixels,127->29 RGB colors, alpha exact; weighted Oklab nearest observed output palette matches all pixels, unweighted81 and sRGB50 mismatches.
No drift_threshold override in selected parsed capture dictionaries; retained MiniMax/V3 packets expose main images without before/after pair.
No animation foreground de-flicker transform, threshold metric/default, palette clustering algorithm or private internal stage recovered.

limitations: Source array order/co-location are pairing basis; not optical-flow foreground correspondence across moving frames.
Observed output palette is reused after the fact, not an independent or supplied-palette prediction.
No observed before/after animation color change; identical arrays cannot expose the omitted earlier stage.
Temporal variance reduction and whole-PixelLab-pipeline replication are unproved.
Initial measurement and interrupted-v2 outputs remain private; source-pinned-v3 is the final complete receipt.

capture_writer_review.finding: Captures scrub secrets/URL queries and serialize safe responses; no variant-field swap or quantizer in these capture functions. Export extraction deduplicates PNG hashes; review decodes response descriptors directly instead. Historical HAR contains scrubbed/reserialized response values, not original HTTP byte preservation.
